items.definition:
relating to the nervous system
The patient presented with several neurologic symptoms.

relating to or denoting phenol or its derivatives
Phenolic resins are used in the production of various plastics.

serving as a typical example of something
He is the prototypical example of a successful entrepreneur.

having or displaying a strict moral or religious code
His puritanical views made him unpopular at the liberal arts college.

thin and weak in sound; full of reeds
His voice was reedy and high-pitched, making it difficult to hear him clearly.

relating to or suffering from rheumatism or joint pain
He suffered from rheumatic fever as a child, which affected his heart.

stiffly formal or unnatural
His speech was rather stilted, lacking natural flow.

relating to a tube, especially a fallopian tube
The doctor performed a tubal ligation.

persisting despite discouragement
Despite the setbacks, she remained undeterred in her pursuit of the goal.

not pleasant to taste; difficult to accept
The truth, though unpalatable, had to be faced.

of, relating to, or appearing in the spring
The vernal equinox marks the beginning of spring.

bitter and angry in speech or manner
Their divorce was an acrimonious affair.

lacking government or control; chaotic
The protest turned into an anarchic scene.

relating to atmospheric pressure
The barometric pressure dropped significantly before the storm.

operating in two directions
The new road has bidirectional traffic lanes.

courteous and honorable, especially towards women
He was praised for his chivalrous behavior.

deserving contempt; despicable
His actions were utterly contemptible and showed a lack of respect for others.

relentlessly severe, stern, or gloomy in manner or appearance
The dour expression on his face suggested he was not pleased.

successful in producing a desired or intended result; effective
The new medicine proved to be highly efficacious in treating the disease.

relating to the conversion of electrical and mechanical energy
The device uses an electromechanical system to operate.

capable of being extended
The software was designed to be extensible, allowing for future additions.

having or showing the symptoms of a fever; characterized by a great deal of nervous excitement or energy
The patient presented with a febrile illness.

Produced in the throat; harsh-sounding
He spoke in a deep, guttural voice.

Overly theatrical or exaggerated
His acting was a bit hammy, but entertaining.

rude and disrespectful
His impertinent remarks offended the elderly woman.
